**Review scope** (select one)

- [ ] Routine change within existing contracts.
- [ ] Significant shared-contract, lifecycle, compatibility, security-boundary, or release-permission change.
- [ ] Governance or project-direction decision.

<!--
Routine: one independent Maintainer approval plus relevant checks.
Significant: a design discussion and two independent technical approvals, including one Maintainer.
The second reviewer may be a qualified Contributor without write access.
Governance/direction: a recorded TSC decision plus the applicable implementation review.
Authors and bots do not count as independent human reviewers; officer titles add no approval authority.
Approvals are submitted GitHub Reviews, not /lgtm or /approve comments or labels.
For ownership changes, update MAINTAINERS.md and OWNERS together, run make sync-codeowners,
and include the generated .github/CODEOWNERS. Existing base-branch owners review the change.
These are merger checks, not a request to obtain approval before opening a PR.
-->
